mapper.select: SELECT DEPT_CD AS deptCd, DEPT_NM AS deptNm FROM ODS.S_PDEDBMSM ORDER BY SORT_SEQ

SELECT MDFM_ID AS mdfmId, MDFM_FOM_SEQ AS mdfmFormSeq, MDFM_SCTN_SEQ AS mdfmSctnSeq, SCTN_DGN_META_LDAT AS sctnDgnMetaLdat FROM ODS.S_MRFMFSCD WHERE 1=1 AND MDFM_ID = #{mdfmId} AND MDFM_FOM_SEQ = #{mdfmFomSeq} ORDER BY MDFM_ID, MDFM_FOM_SEQ, MDFM_SCTN_SEQ

SELECT K.MDRC_ID AS mdrcId, K.MDRC_FOM_SEQ AS mdrcFomSeq, K.MDFM_CPEM_ID AS mdfmCpemId, K.MDFM_CPEM_NO AS mdfmCpemNo, -- ID K.MDRC_CMPS_SEQ AS mdrcCmpsSeq, K.REC_VAL_SEQ AS recValSeq, K.MDFM_ELMT_CCLS_CD AS mdfmElmtCclsCd, K.MDFM_ELMT_OPTP_CD AS mdfmElmtOptpCd, K.SGKY_NO AS sgkyNo, K.MGPT_TP_CHR_VAL AS mgptTpChrVal, K.VALUE_TYPE AS valueType, -- IF V.MDFM_ELMT_INPT_CNTE AS mdfmElmtInptCnte, -- V면 V.MDFM_ELMT_INPT_TAG_CNTE AS mdfmElmtInptTagCnte, LV.DCST_LDAT AS dcstLdat, -- LV면 LV.FSRC_DCST_LDAT AS fsrcDcstLdat, LV.FCHG_DCST_LDAT AS fchgDcstLdat, LV.IMG_TMPL_PATH_NM AS imgTmplPathNm, LV.IMG_NOAT_CNTE AS imgNoatCnte, LV.INTG_IMG_FILE_PATH_NM AS intgImgFilePathNm FROM ( SELECT MDRC_ID, MDRC_FOM_SEQ, MDFM_CPEM_ID, MDFM_CPEM_NO, MDRC_CMPS_SEQ, REC_VAL_SEQ, MDFM_ELMT_CCLS_CD, MDFM_ELMT_OPTP_CD, SGKY_NO, MGPT_TP_CHR_VAL, 'V' AS VALUE_TYPE FROM ODS.S_MRDDRECE WHERE 1 = 1 AND MDRC_ID = #{mdrcId} AND MDRC_FOM_SEQ = #{mdrcFomSeq} UNION ALL SELECT MDRC_ID, MDRC_FOM_SEQ, MDFM_CPEM_ID, MDFM_CPEM_NO, MDRC_CMPS_SEQ, REC_VAL_SEQ, MDFM_ELMT_CCLS_CD, MDFM_ELMT_OPTP_CD, SGKY_NO, MGPT_TP_CHR_VAL, 'LV' AS VALUE_TYPE FROM ODS.S_MRDDRLFE WHERE 1 = 1 AND MDRC_ID = #{mdrcId} AND MDRC_FOM_SEQ = #{mdrcFomSeq} ) K LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT MDRC_ID, MDRC_FOM_SEQ, MDFM_CPEM_ID, MDFM_CPEM_NO, MDFM_ELMT_INPT_CNTE, MDFM_ELMT_INPT_TAG_CNTE FROM ODS.S_MRDDRECE WHERE 1 = 1 AND MDRC_ID = #{mdrcId} AND MDRC_FOM_SEQ = #{mdrcFomSeq} ) V ON K.MDRC_ID = V.MDRC_ID AND K.MDRC_FOM_SEQ = V.MDRC_FOM_SEQ AND K.MDFM_CPEM_ID = V.MDFM_CPEM_ID AND K.MDFM_CPEM_NO = V.MDFM_CPEM_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT MDRC_ID, MDRC_FOM_SEQ, MDFM_CPEM_ID, MDFM_CPEM_NO, DCST_LDAT, FSRC_DCST_LDAT, FCHG_DCST_LDAT, IMG_TMPL_PATH_NM, IMG_NOAT_CNTE, INTG_IMG_FILE_PATH_NM FROM ODS.S_MRDDRLFE WHERE 1 = 1 AND MDRC_ID = #{mdrcId} AND MDRC_FOM_SEQ = #{mdrcFomSeq} ) LV ON K.MDRC_ID = LV.MDRC_ID AND K.MDRC_FOM_SEQ = LV.MDRC_FOM_SEQ AND K.MDFM_CPEM_ID = LV.MDFM_CPEM_ID AND K.MDFM_CPEM_NO = LV.MDFM_CPEM_NO

SELECT 'DR' AS recordType , B.COMN_CD_NM AS itemType , C.MDFM_NM AS itemNm , A.MDF_REC_DTM AS writingDate , A.WRTR_DEPT_CD AS writingDeptCd , (SELECT Z.DEPT_NM FROM ODS.S_PDEDBMSM Z WHERE Z.DEPT_CD = A.WRTR_DEPT_CD) AS writingDeptNm , A.WRT_STF_NO AS writerStfNo , (SELECT Z.STF_NM FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD Z WHERE Z.STF_NO = A.WRT_STF_NO) AS writerNm , 'DR_' || A.MDFM_CLS_CD || '_' || A.MDFM_CLS_DTL_CD || '_' || A.MDRC_ID || '_' || A.MDRC_FOM_SEQ AS keyId , A.MDRC_ID AS mdrcId , CASE WHEN MDRC_WRT_STS_CD IN ('11', '12') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS mdrcWrtStsCd , CASE WHEN MDRC_WRT_STS_CD IN ('11', '12') THEN A.MDRC_ID || '_' || A.MDRC_FOM_SEQ END AS dgnsRerRcdcNo , NVL((SELECT MAX('Y') FROM ODS.S_MRDDREPG Z WHERE Z.MDRC_ID = A.MDRC_ID AND Z.MDRC_FOM_SEQ = A.MDRC_FOM_SEQ AND PRNT_YN = 'Y'), 'N') AS prntYn , DECODE(A.PACT_TP_CD, 'I', '입원', 'O', '외래', 'E', '응급') AS pactTpCd , A.HSP_TP_CD AS hspTpCd , A.PT_NO AS ptNo FROM ODS.S_MRDDRECM A , ODS.S_CCCCCSTE B , ODS.S_MRFMFORM C WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.PT_NO = #{ptNo} AND A.LST_YN = 'Y' AND A.MDRC_DC_TP_CD = 'C' AND A.MDFM_CLS_CD IN ('D009', 'D035') AND B.COMN_GRP_CD = 'RDO062' AND B.COMN_CD = A.MDFM_CLS_DTL_CD AND C.MDFM_CLS_CD = A.MDFM_CLS_CD AND C.MDFM_ID = A.MDFM_ID AND C.MDFM_FOM_SEQ = A.MDFM_FOM_SEQ ORDER BY REC_DTM DESC

SELECT 'DR' AS recordType, A.MDFM_CLS_CD AS recordDetailType, COMN.COMN_CD_NM AS itemType, COMN.COMN_CD_NM AS itemNm, NVL(B.OP_DTM::DATE, A.MDF_REC_DTM::DATE) AS writingDate, A.WRTR_DEPT_CD AS writingDeptCd, DEPT.DEPT_NM AS writingDeptNm, A.WRT_STF_NO AS writerStfNo, STFF.STF_NM AS writerNm, NULL AS keyId, A.PACT_ID AS pactId, DECODE(A.PACT_TP_CD, 'I', '입원', 'O', '외래', 'E', '응급', NULL) AS pactTpCd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TO_CHAR(A.MDF_REC_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY A.REC_DTM DESC) AS sortSeq, NULL AS note, A.MDFM_ID AS mdfmId, A.MDFM_FOM_SEQ AS mdfmFomSeq, A.MDRC_ID AS mdrcId, A.MDRC_FOM_SEQ AS mdrcFomSeq, NULL AS examKey, NULL AS pacsImgIptnCd, NULL AS accsId, NULL AS recType, NULL AS geneExmYn, CASE WHEN A.MDRC_WRT_STS_CD > 10 THEN 'Y' END AS mdrcWrtStsCdYn, NULL AS opExptRegId FROM ODS.S_MRDDRECM A LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_MRDDRONE B ON A.MDRC_ID = B.MDRC_ID AND A.MDRC_FOM_SEQ = B.MDRC_FOM_SEQ LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_CCCCCSTE COMN ON COMN.COMN_GRP_CD = 'RDO062' AND A.MDFM_CLS_DTL_CD = COMN.COMN_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_PDEDBMSM DEPT ON A.WRTR_DEPT_CD = DEPT.DEPT_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_CNLRRUSD STFF ON A.WRT_STF_NO = STFF.STF_NO WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.PT_NO = #{ptNo} AND A.MDFM_CLS_CD = 'D005' AND ((B.OP_DTM::DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.OP_DTM::DATE BETWEEN #{searchFromDate}::DATE AND #{searchToDate}::DATE) OR (B.OP_DTM::DATE IS NULL AND A.MDF_REC_DTM::DATE BETWEEN #{searchFromDate}::DATE AND #{searchToDate}::DATE)) AND A.PACT_TP_CD = DECODE(#{pactTpCd}, 'ALL', A.PACT_TP_CD, #{pactTpCd}) AND A.LST_YN = 'Y' AND A.MDRC_DC_TP_CD = 'C' AND B.OPRC_ELMT_CLS_CD = '17' AND A.PT_MED_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND A.WRTR_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND A.WK_SID = #{writerStfNo} AND A.WK_STF_NO = #{writerStfNo} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ODS.S_MRFMFORM Z WHERE A.MDFM_ID = Z.MDFM_ID AND A.MDFM_FOM_SEQ = Z.MDFM_FOM_SEQ AND Z.MDFM_CLS_CD = 'D020' AND Z.MDFM_APY_CTRA_CD = 4) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD Z WHERE Z.STF_NO = A.WRT_STF_NO AND Z.OCTY_TP_CD = 'Z06') ORDER BY writingDate DESC, sortSeq

SELECT 'DR' AS recordType, A.MDFM_CLS_CD AS recordDetailType, COMN.COMN_CD_NM AS itemType, COMN.COMN_CD_NM AS itemNm, CASE WHEN A.MDFM_CLS_CD IN ('D001', 'D002', 'D003', 'D004', 'D031') THEN A.MED_DT ELSE A.MDF_REC_DTM::DATE END AS writingDate, A.WRTR_DEPT_CD AS writingDeptCd, DEPT.DEPT_NM AS writingDeptNm, A.WRT_STF_NO AS writerStfNo, STFF.STF_NM AS writerNm, NULL AS keyId, A.PACT_ID AS pactId, DECODE(A.PACT_TP_CD, 'I', '입원', 'O', '외래', 'E', '응급', NULL) AS pactTpCd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TO_CHAR(A.MDF_REC_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY A.REC_DTM DESC) AS sortSeq, NULL AS note, A.MDFM_ID AS mdfmId, A.MDFM_FOM_SEQ AS mdfmFomSeq, A.MDRC_ID AS mdrcId, A.MDRC_FOM_SEQ AS mdrcFomSeq, NULL AS examKey, NULL AS pacsImgIptnCd, NULL AS accsId, NULL AS recType, NULL AS geneExmYn, CASE WHEN A.MDRC_WRT_STS_CD > 10 THEN 'Y' END AS mdrcWrtStsCdYn, NULL AS opExptRegId FROM ODS.S_MRDDRECM A LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_CCCCCSTE COMN ON COMN.COMN_GRP_CD = 'RDO062' AND A.MDFM_CLS_DTL_CD = COMN.COMN_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_PDEDBMSM DEPT ON A.WRTR_DEPT_CD = DEPT.DEPT_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_CNLRRUSD STFF ON A.WRT_STF_NO = STFF.STF_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_MRFMFORM FORM ON A.MDFM_ID = FORM.MDFM_ID AND A.MDFM_FOM_SEQ = FORM.MDFM_FOM_SEQ WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.PT_NO = #{ptNo} AND A.MDFM_CLS_CD = 'D007' AND A.MDF_REC_DTM::DATE BETWEEN #{searchFromDate}::DATE AND #{searchToDate}::DATE AND A.PACT_TP_CD = DECODE(#{pactTpCd}, 'ALL', A.PACT_TP_CD, #{pactTpCd}) AND A.LST_YN = 'Y' AND A.MDRC_DC_TP_CD = 'C' AND A.PT_MED_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND A.WRTR_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND A.WK_SID = #{writerStfNo} AND A.WK_STF_NO = #{writerStfNo} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD Z WHERE Z.STF_NO = A.WRT_STF_NO AND Z.OCTY_TP_CD = 'Z06') ORDER BY writingDate DESC, sortSeq

SELECT 'DR' AS recordType , A.MDFM_CLS_CD AS recordDetailType , COMN.COMN_CD_NM AS itemType , COMN.COMN_CD_NM AS itemNm , NVL(B.DS_DT, A.MDF_REC_DTM::DATE) AS writingDate , A.WRTR_DEPT_CD AS writingDeptCd , DEPT.DEPT_NM AS writingDeptNm , A.WK_STF_NO AS writerStfNo , STFF.STF_NM AS writerNm , NULL AS keyId , A.PACT_ID AS pactId , DECODE(A.PACT_TP_CD, 'I', '입원', 'O', '외래', 'E', '응급', NULL) AS pactTpCd , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TO_CHAR(A.MDF_REC_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY A.REC_DTM DESC) AS sortSeq , NULL AS note , A.MDFM_ID AS mdfmId , A.MDFM_FOM_SEQ AS mdfmFomSeq , A.MDRC_ID AS mdrcId , A.MDRC_FOM_SEQ AS mdrcFomSeq , NULL AS examKey , NULL AS pacsImgIptnCd , NULL AS accsId , NULL AS recType , NULL AS geneExmYn , CASE WHEN A.MDRC_WRT_STS_CD > 10 THEN 'Y' END AS mdrcWrtStsCdYn , NULL AS opExptRegId FROM ODS.S_MRDDRECM A LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT Q.PT_NO AS PT_NO , Q.PACT_ID AS PACT_ID , Q.DS_DTM AS DS_DT FROM ODS.S_ACPPRAAM Q WHERE Q.PT_NO = #{ptNo} UNION ALL SELECT Q.PT_NO AS PT_NO , Q.PACT_ID AS PACT_ID , Q.CHOT_DTM AS DS_DT FROM ODS.S_ACPPRETM Q WHERE Q.PT_NO = #{ptNo} ) B ON A.PT_NO = B.PT_NO AND A.PACT_ID = B.PACT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_CCCCCSTE COMN ON COMN.COMN_GRP_CD = 'RDO062' AND A.MDFM_CLS_DTL_CD = COMN.COMN_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_PDEDBMSM DEPT ON A.WRTR_DEPT_CD = DEPT.DEPT_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_CNLRRUSD STFF ON A.WRT_STF_NO = STFF.STF_NO WHERE 1=1 AND A.PT_NO = #{ptNo} AND A.MDFM_CLS_CD = 'D006' /* 퇴원기록 */ AND A.PACT_TP_CD = DECODE(#{pactTpCd}, 'ALL', A.PACT_TP_CD, #{pactTpCd}) AND A.PT_MED_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND A.WRTR_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND A.WK_SID = #{writerStfNo} AND A.WK_STF_NO = #{writerStfNo} AND A.LST_YN = 'Y' AND A.MDRC_DC_TP_CD = 'C' AND ((B.DS_DT::DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.DS_DT::DATE BETWEEN #{searchFromDate}::DATE AND #{searchToDate}::DATE AND A.PT_NO = B.PT_NO AND A.PACT_ID = B.PACT_ID) OR (B.DS_DT::DATE IS NULL AND A.MDF_REC_DTM::DATE BETWEEN #{searchFromDate}::DATE AND #{searchToDate}::DATE)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 'Y' FROM ODS.S_CNLRRUSD W WHERE W.STF_NO = A.WRT_STF_NO AND W.OCTY_TP_CD IN ('Z06') )

SELECT 'OR' AS recordType , 'OR' AS recordDetailType , '처방' AS itemType , '처방' || '(' || TO_CHAR(A.ORD_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ')' AS itemNm , A.ORD_DT AS writingDate , A.PT_HME_DEPT_CD AS writingDeptCd , DEPT.DEPT_NM AS writingDeptNm , NULL AS writerStfNo , NULL AS writerNm , NULL AS keyId , NULL AS pactId , DECODE(A.MED_PACT_TP_CD, 'I', '입원', 'O', '외래', 'E', '응급', NULL) AS pactTpCd , NULL AS sortSeq , NULL AS note , NULL AS mdfmId , NULL AS mdfmFomSeq , NULL AS mdrcId , NULL AS mdrcFomSeq , NULL AS examKey , NULL AS pacsImgIptnCd , NULL AS accsId , NULL AS recType , NULL AS geneExmYn , NULL AS mdrcWrtStsCdYn , NULL AS opExptRegId FROM ODS.S_MOOORPTD A LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_PDEDBMSM DEPT ON A.PT_HME_DEPT_CD = DEPT.DEPT_CD WHERE 1=1 AND A.PT_NO = #{ptNo} AND A.ORD_DT::DATE BETWEEN #{searchFromDate}::DATE AND #{searchToDate}::DATE AND A.PT_HME_DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL AND A.ODDSC_TP_CD IN ('C', 'D') AND A.ORD_GRP_CD NOT IN ('06', '08') AND A.PT_HME_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND A.PBSO_DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND A.MED_PACT_TP_CD = DECODE(#{pactTpCd}, 'ALL', A.MED_PACT_TP_CD, #{pactTpCd}) GROUP BY A.PT_NO, A.ORD_DT, A.PT_HME_DEPT_CD, DEPT.DEPT_NM, A.MED_PACT_TP_CD

SELECT A.MDRC_ID AS mdrcId, A.MDRC_FOM_SEQ AS mdrcFomSeq, A.MDFM_CLS_CD AS mdfmClsCd, COMN.COMN_CD_NM AS itemType, TO_CHAR(MDF_REC_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS writingDate, TO_CHAR(MDF_REC_DTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI') AS writingDateTime, WRT_DEPT.DEPT_NM AS writingDeptNm, MED_DEPT.DEPT_NM AS medDeptNm, STFF.STF_NM AS writerNm FROM ODS.S_MRDDRECM A LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_CCCCCSTE COMN ON COMN.COMN_GRP_CD = 'RDO062' AND A.MDFM_CLS_DTL_CD = COMN.COMN_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_PDEDBMSM WRT_DEPT ON A.WRTR_DEPT_CD = WRT_DEPT.DEPT_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_PDEDBMSM MED_DEPT ON A.PT_MED_DEPT_CD = MED_DEPT.DEPT_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_CNLRRUSD STFF ON A.WRT_STF_NO = STFF.STF_NO WHERE MDRC_ID = #{mdrcId} AND MDRC_FOM_SEQ = #{mdrcFomSeq}
